scripts.predev: lsof -tnP -iTCP:3100,4100 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo 'predev: ports 3100/4100 ready'
scripts.dev: npm run dev:web & npm run dev:api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tctm/web && npm run build -w @tctm/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @tctm/api && npm run lint -w @tctm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tctm/api && npm run typecheck -w @tctm/web
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:drop -w @tctm/api && npm run db:create -w @tctm/api && npm run db:migrate -w @tctm/api && npm run db:seed -w @tctm/api && npm run db:seed:tasks -w @tctm/api
